sentences.text:
7 March, 2025
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice J. Sreenivas Rao
 Contempt Case No.274 of 2020
Order:

This contempt case is filed to punish the respondents- contemnors for gross violation of the interim order passed by this Court, dated 11.10.2018 in I.A.No.1 of 2018 in Writ Petition No.37553 of 2018 invoking the provisions under Sections 10 to 12 of the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971.
2. No representation on behalf of the petitioner.

3. Respondent No.2 filed counter affidavit on 25.01.2022, wherein it is specifically stated in para No.7 as follows:
"7.

It is respondent espectfully submitted that the Government taken up proposal for widening the existing road to 215' wide road from Narayanamma College to Gachibowli Flyover, as approved under the Master Plan, and the GHMC and since inception the petitioner and her mother have been creating hurdles by filing repeated writ petitions with false allegations.

In view of their non- cooperation, the matter was referred to the Land Acquisition Officer for disbursal of the compensation, with due intimation to the effected parties through official communication and acquired the land and executed the road widening works, as per the approved alignment, even prior to the filing of the present writ petition and she was not in possession of any piece of the acquired land at the time of filing the writ petition.
As such the question of causing any manner of further interference into the possession of the petitioner, is mere imaginary and the same does not arise.

Similarly, the removal of alleged ramp etc., are part of the road widening works within the acquired piece of land, which were executed and completed even prior to the filing of the writ petition, hence, there is no occasion of violating the orders of the Hon'ble Court and the petitioner is put to strict proof of the same."
4.
From the record, it reveals that the petitioner has not filed any reply denying the said averments.
5. In view of the same, this Court is of the considered view that no further adjudication is required.
6. Accordingly, the Contempt Case is closed.
However, the petitioner is granted liberty to raise all grounds which are available under law in pending writ petition.
Miscellaneous applications, pending if any, shall stand closed.
